notes.title: V 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975108/db2e4b58b328c31ab2a45b3f14ad218ff394de24.jpg[/img]The most critical feedback we received was about the controls and camera. In the new version, we've added an auto-follow feature for the camera. Please try it out and leave your feedback. You can turn it off in the settings if you don't like it.

Thank you all for trying our prologue, and please wishlist the full game if you enjoyed it!

[h2][b]New Content:[/b][/h2]
 - Added magnet trinket, (+25% pickup range)

[h2][b]Improvements and Quality of Life:[/b][/h2]
 - Camera
    - Added camera auto follow, this logic can be turned off in the settings.
 - Movement
    - Improved the preservation of momentum when transitioning between driving and turning in place.
 
- UI
    - Improved the description of the Luck attribute on crewmembers. 
    - Add more shortcut keys for keyboard and mouse control
    - Increased the cursor size
    - Added material cost in the Upgrade Panel

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
    - Fixed minor bugs in the tutorial levels
    - When interacting with the Gacha Altar, the prompt to purchase another will reappear after picking up the Gacha Ball, and you will no longer need to exit the interaction circle and re-enter to trigger the prompt. 
    - When your Ark has hit the Crew limit and you increase the Crew limit while inside an interaction circle related to rescuing crewmembers, you will no longer need to exit the interaction circle and re-enter to trigger the rescue process.

notes.title: STEAM ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY FEST 2024 LIVE STREAM EVENT
notes.notes:
Date: 05/13/2024 10AM PST- 05/20/2023 10PM PST

[b]This event marks the debut of the first playable demo![/b] It's a groundbreaking moment for Zombie Rollerz fans everywhere. Gone are the days of offline exhibitions; now, you can finally battle zombies from the comfort of your home! For the first time ever, players can download the demo and experience the thrilling prologue of Zombie Rollerz: The Last Ship. Witness the beginning of the adventure firsthand and prepare for the ultimate showdown against the zombie horde!

Event Highlights:

Live Gameplay: Watch as our team of developers dives into the updated demo, showcasing the improvements and enhancements.  See firsthand how these changes make your zombie-fighting adventure even more captivating.

Community Engagement: Engage with fellow gamers as we discuss your thoughts, suggestions, and excitement about the updated demo.  Share your feedback and predictions for the full game release.

What's New:

Bug Fixes: We've been hard at work squashing pesky bugs that might have crept into the previous version. Experience smoother, glitch-free gameplay as you navigate through the zombie-infested world.

Exciting New Features: Prepare to be amazed by the exciting new features we've added. From powerful weapons to dynamic environments, the Last Ship is more thrilling than ever before.

Joining the Event:
Don't miss this opportunity to witness the enhanced and action-packed world of Zombie Rollerz - The Last Ship.  Follow our store page, add game to your wish list and set your reminders to catch the live event.

Prepare for a thrilling adventure filled with relentless zombie hordes, heart-pounding action, and the chance to be among the first to experience the demo.
